title: 비슷한 말과 반대말: 같아요? 달라요? 틀려요?
objective: By the end, you can use 같다, 비슷하다, 다르다, 틀리다 and related words correctly in short sentences, and you can tell 다르다 (different) from 틀리다 (wrong).
summary: Learn ten everyday words for comparing things: same, similar, different, opposite, right and wrong.

task.title: Use the right word
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose, fill in, or write the word that fits best.

words.exampleMeaning: We work at the same company.
My friend bought the exact same bag as mine.
My older sister and I have similar voices.

words.meaning: to be wrong, to get (an answer) wrong; not 'different'
words.exampleMeaning: I got two questions wrong on the test.
What's the difference between the two words?

words.example: 이 옷이 작아서 큰 옷으로 바꿨어요.
words.exampleMeaning: This outfit was small, so I exchanged it for a bigger one.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 계산이 (달라서 / 틀려서) 다시 했어요. ② 저하고 동생은 성격이 (달라요 / 틀려요).
Fill in the blank with 같다, 비슷하다, or 똑같다 in the right form: ① 저하고 친구는 생일이 ____. 둘 다 5월 3일이에요. ② 두 식당의 김치는 맛이 ____ 조금 달라요.
Write the opposite word (반대말): ① 길다 ② 쉽다 ③ 맞다
Choose the right word: A: 이 두 사진, 뭐가 달라요? B: 글쎄요, 저는 (차이를 / 뜻을) 잘 모르겠어요.
Fill in the blank with 맞다 in the right form: A: 이 버스가 시청에 가요? B: 네, ____.
Complete the sentence with 바꾸다 in the past polite form (-았/었어요): 이 옷이 작아서 큰 옷으로 ____.
answers: ① 짧다 ② 어렵다 ③ 틀리다
